# FLUX 3 edit, before and after

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-edit-before-after.json`](../flux3/flux3-edit-before-after.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 7 |
| Links | 6 |
| Paid API calls per run | **1** |

---

One instruction edit with the source and the result laid over each other, so you judge what changed by sliding across it rather than by flicking between two previews.

**Image Comparer** (rgthree) takes the original as `image_a` and the edit as `image_b`. Hover and drag across it; set its `comparer_mode` property to *Click* if you prefer toggling.

`resolution` is **match_input**, so both sides are the same size and line up pixel for pixel — which is what makes the slider honest. Pixels outside the edited element should not move; where they do (shadows, reflections, nearby light), the slider shows it.

**Display Any** (rgthree) shows `expanded_prompt`: how FLUX 3 rewrote the instruction, and the boxes it drew around what it decided to change. If it picked the wrong thing, copy those rows into **flux3-box-edit**.

`variation` is fixed, so re-running with nothing changed costs nothing.

### Needs
[rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy). **Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes** finds it if the graph loads with red nodes.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds every FLUX 3 `prompt` in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list, so each node it feeds still runs once.
